The ringing in her ears begins to recede. Vivica looks up, and sees Eliza is slumped against the wall staring at the ceiling a few feet away.  She shakes her head. In the far corner of the room she sees a small figure curled up. It's a young Vivica,  small, only a child. She's crying for her parents. Begging them not to immigrate here. Vivica's chest tightens "If they had listened I wouldn't be here." a tear drips down her face. "I want to go home again" she says aloud, thinking of France.  The child lifts her face, her eyes are blackened holes that stare directly into Vivica's eyes. She brings her knees to her chest and sobs feeling as small as her child self. 
"Home?" Eliza's gaze sweeps across the room as she echos Vivica. She sees her younger self, back to her. Elizas reminded of those days back in FerryTown. She gets flashes of images, dreaming of standing up against the redcoats, wanting to protect others. "Look where those dreams got me." She thinks. Her eyes shift to Vivica whos sobbing. "I wish I could go back. Its not far from here." She too begins to cry. She watches her younger self slip away into the nothing. A feeling she wishes she could mimic in this moment.
(Ok last one for tonight, these are so fun to write and I love working with Eliza on them.)
